about: Main Event on Guilford College Road is the Greensboro stop for Pancakes at the North Pole.
The date is Sunday, December 13, 2026.
Check-in starts at 10:45 AM and the activities run from 11 AM to 1:30 PM.
Families build their own pancakes at the breakfast.
Kids decorate sugar cookies at a craft table.
They also write letters to Santa and enter a seasonal coloring contest.
Each ticket includes two hours of unlimited activities and one hour of game play.
A digital meet and greet photo with Santa's pals is part of the ticket.
A single ticket is $35.96 and the family 4-pack is $108.96.
Tax and gratuity are included in both prices.
Children must be with an adult.
Tickets are sold through Fever.

about: The Asheville Tourists host this breakfast at HomeTrust Park.
It is on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 9 to 11 AM.
The ballpark address is 30 Buchanan Place.
The buffet has scrambled eggs, bacon, sausage and breakfast potatoes.
Mini pancakes come with toppings, and there are spiced apples too.
Juice, coffee and tea are served.
Santa and Mrs. Claus visit the tables.
Kids play reindeer games during the morning.
Photos with Santa are free, but a photographer is not provided.
Adult tickets are $31.50 and child tickets are $21.50.
Both ticket types showed as sold out on November 27.
The Tourists can be reached at 828-575-1011.
faq: When is Breakfast with Santa at HomeTrust Park?
Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 9 to 11 AM.
Where is it?
HomeTrust Park, 30 Buchanan Pl, Asheville, NC.
How much are tickets?
$31.50 for adults and $21.50 for children.
Is it sold out?
Tickets showed as sold out on November 27, so call 828-575-1011 to ask about openings.
What food is served?
Eggs, bacon, sausage, potatoes, mini pancakes, spiced apples and drinks.
Is there a photographer?
No, but families can take their own photos with Santa for free.

Santa and Mrs. Claus.
